messages.subject: Help with parallel
parts:
Hello Everyone,

I have been trying to setup the parallel function to run multiple chains in nimble. But I face an issue which I'm not sure how to rectify. The code runs without any issue if I don't use parallel. please find attached my code.

gapCode <- nimbleCode({
  for (t in 1:mxpq){
    psi[t] <- omega
    g[t] ~ dgamma(shape=eta, scale=psi[t]/eta)
  }
  for( t in (mxpq+1):T){
    psi[t] <- omega+inprod(durpar[1:p],g[(t-p):(t-1)])+inprod(durpar[(p+1):(p+q)],psi[(t-q):(t-1)])
    g[t] ~ dgamma(shape=eta, scale=psi[t]/eta)
  }
    for (i in 1:k){
    gamdirch[i] ~ dgamma(shape=0.5,rate=1)
  }
  for (i in 1:k){
    durpar[i] <- gamdirch[i]/sum(gamdirch[1:k])
  }
  eta ~ dgamma(shape=0.001,scale=1/0.001)
  omega ~ dgamma(shape=0.001,scale=1/0.001)
})

# Gap between refresh times:
gamma_t=as.numeric(gamma_t)

T=length(gamma_t)-20
p=2
q=2
mxpq <- max(p,q)
k=p+q+1

useWAIC <- TRUE

run_MCMC_allcode <- function(seed, data, code, useWAIC = TRUE) {
  library(nimble)
 
  T=T
  p=2
  q=2
  mxpq <- max(p,q)
  k=p+q+1
 
  # Running nimble code:
  gapModel <- nimbleModel(code = code,
                               constants = list(T = T,p=p,q=q,k=k,mxpq=mxpq,alpha = rep(0.5, k))
                               ,data = data
                               ,inits = list(eta=1,omega=0.001))
 
  mcmcConf <- configureMCMC(gapModel, monitors = c("eta","omega","durpar"),
                            enableWAIC = TRUE,useConjugacy = FALSE)
  Rmcmc<-buildMCMC(mcmcConf)
  Cmodel<-compileNimble(gapModel)
  Cmcmc <- compileNimble(Rmcmc, project = gapModel)
  samplesList <- runMCMC(Cmcmc, niter = 5000, thin=1, nburnin = 0
                         ,samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE, WAIC = TRUE)
  return(samplesList)
 
}

chain_output <- parLapply(cl = this_cluster, X = 1:2,
                          fun = run_MCMC_allcode,
                          data = list(g=gamma_t[1:T]), code =  gapCode,
                          useWAIC = useWAIC)

stopCluster(this_cluster)

This is the error i receive:

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) : 2 nodes produced errors; first error: confused assigning unrolledIndicesMatrixRow in case with no unrolledRows by numUnrolledNodes != 1 for code psi[t] <- omega + inprod(durpar[1:2], g[(t - 2):(t - 1)]) + inprod(durpar[3:4], psi[(t - 2):(t - 1)])

Any help will be appreciated.

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: Help with parallel
parts:
One thing I did notice is that you seem to rely on the value of `T` being found as a global variable from outside of the function and its arguments. My initial suggestion would be to make sure you are setting T based on the function's arguments. It may be that T is not found for the workers and is being implicitly set to the value 1 because R treats `T` as `TRUE` which would be coerced to the numeric value of 1.

If that's not the issue, let me know and please also provide `gamma_t` so I can run your code.

-chris
